[🎨] Paint a Rug

🎨 Make your own rug to match the prompt before time runs out!
🤖 AI judges your accuracy — the highest score wins!

💵 Earn money from matches to unlock cosmetics and more!
🏆 Can you make a better rug than your opponent?

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game to support future updates!

⚠️ Inappropriate artwork may result in a permanent ban.
